name: Ondue
summary: A mint autopay console that pays a small business's bills on time, by rules you set
about: A complete app for paying a small business's regular bills on time, with its suppliers, payment rules, bills, client invoices, accounts and projects, in a light and a dark mint theme. The autopay conveyor shows the next 30 days of bills riding toward Paid, each coloured by the rule that will pay it, and running today's autopay sends them into the bin. Rules are ordered, switchable and testable, and every bill rolls up into a project budget.
how: Watch the conveyor on Console, click a bill box for details, and press Run today's autopay
Approve bills over your limit, hold a bill, or pay one now with a confirm step
Reorder, switch off, edit or add payment rules, then test a supplier and amount to see which rule fires
Add suppliers with an IBAN check, and bills that pick up their rule as you type
Track each project's budget against paid and open bills, and mark client invoices paid
Collapse the sidebar to icons, switch the spend chart range, and move money with a review step
